case.title: Archiving an article removes it automatically from Saved News

steps.targetDescription: Locate the news card anywhere with title 'Take the next step in your development at UKG'
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has([data-testid='news-title']:text-is('Take the next step in your development at UKG'))

steps.targetDescription: Ensure article is currently unsaved before proceeding
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has([data-testid='news-title']:text-is('Take the next step in your development at UKG')) [data-testid='bookmark-toggle'][aria-pressed='false']

steps.targetDescription: Save the article from its card
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has([data-testid='news-title']:text-is('Take the next step in your development at UKG')) [data-testid='bookmark-toggle']

steps.targetDescription: Saved state confirmed on the card
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has([data-testid='news-title']:text-is('Take the next step in your development at UKG')) [data-testid='bookmark-toggle'][aria-pressed='true']

steps.targetDescription: Open the article detail from the card
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has([data-testid='news-title']:text-is('Take the next step in your development at UKG')) [data-testid='news-title']

steps.assertion: Take the next step in your development at UKG

steps.targetDescription: Archive the article via QA admin control
Archived article is no longer present in saved list
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has([data-testid='news-title']:text-is('Take the next step in your development at UKG'))

steps.targetDescription: Return to article page to unarchive for cleanup
Unarchive the article via QA admin control (cleanup)
Return to home to confirm card state
Card shows unsaved state after archive/remove cycle
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has([data-testid='news-title']:text-is('Take the next step in your development at UKG')) [data-testid='bookmark-toggle'][aria-pressed='false']
